_comment: MCP server catalogue for India AI Ad Creator. See AGENTS.md > 'MCP usage' for rules. Hosted MCPs use OAuth so no shell tokens needed; locally-spawned ones read tokens from your shell or ~/.config/claude/.env.

next-devtools._purpose: Next.js 16 dev-server state: routes, build errors, runtime/type errors, server actions, project metadata. Auto-discovers the Next.js dev server when `pnpm dev` is running.

supabase._purpose: Read-write access to the linked Supabase project (database, auth, edge functions, storage, branching). OAuth on first use — no SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN needed.

cloudflare-r2._purpose: Inspect R2 buckets (uploads, processed, public) and presign objects. OAuth on first use.

cloudflare-observability._purpose: Cloudflare cache analytics, Turnstile challenges, R2 metrics. OAuth on first use.

vercel._purpose: Deploy status, env-var inspection, function logs, preview URL fetch. OAuth on first use.

sentry._purpose: Issue search, event details, release tagging. OAuth on first use.

posthog._purpose: Query events, funnel checks, feature-flag state. Needs POSTHOG_AUTH_HEADER in shell env.

github._purpose: Issue/PR/CI access. Uses GitHub-hosted remote MCP.

shadcn._purpose: Read the local shadcn registry so agents add components by name without re-deriving file shapes.

playwright._purpose: Drive a real browser for E2E debugging and Indic-text snapshot regressions.
